newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania to start polio vaccine for adults.
newsitem.headline: Albania to start polio vaccine for adults.

text.p: Albania plans an urgent immunisation campaign for adults against the deadly polio virus which has already claimed eight lives, officials said.

"The first stage of the campaign will start in October, vaccinating anyone under 50, and it will be held over 10 days simultaneously throughout the country," Jorgo Kosta, a Health Ministry official, told Reuters.
"Some 3.5 million doses paid for by the European Union and other countries will be used in the first stage. The second stage will begin a month after that," Kosta added.
The polio outbreak, which has spread among adults, has killed eight people, with another 66 reported to have contracted the virus, Kosta said.
The epidemic began in April in northwestern Albania and then reached the capital Tirana and other parts of the country.
